pay.title: Scan, pay. That's it.
pay.sub: No app to download, no sign-up form. Scan the QR on the station, a secure payment page opens in your browser, you pay, and the power bank is released.

steps.title: Scan the QR
steps.text: Point your phone camera at the code on the station. Nothing to install.

steps.title: A secure payment page opens
steps.text: It opens right in your browser. No app, no sign-up.

steps.title: Pay with a tap
steps.text: Apple Pay, Google Pay or a credit card.

steps.title: The power bank is released
steps.text: Take it, charge, and return it at any FULLIN station.

demo.alt: FULLIN's secure payment page as it opens after scanning the QR: logo, a note that the charge is 12 NIS per hour and the 200 NIS is a credit-frame guarantee, Apple Pay and Google Pay buttons, credit card fields and a pay 12 NIS per hour button
demo.title: This is the payment page
demo.text: It opens right after the scan: Apple Pay and Google Pay buttons first, card fields below. The only actual charge is ₪12 per hour. The ₪200 is a credit-frame guarantee, not a charge.

vs.text: Scan and pay: ₪12 per hour from the first minute. A free first hour? That's for people who download the app.

pay.terminal: Some stations also have a card terminal. There, too, ₪200 is held as a deposit, just like on the payment page: it is not a charge and is returned after use according to your credit-card company.
